Irene / team — quick ops + billing check-in after reading their redline:

- Maintenance blackouts: ops can accept a 6-hr quarterly blackout exclusion as long as the following are included in the MSA:
  * 21 calendar days notice to the primary technical contact
  * A documented rollback plan and implementation window in the runbook
  * A maximum of 2 scheduled blackout events per 12-month period; additional events trigger review and a possible credit (we should define the credit in the exception matrix)

- If a scheduled maintenance exceeds 6 hours due to an emergency rollback/patch, ops will classify the event and provide incident postmortem; credit treatment depends on whether the overrun was within our control or forced by upstream dependencies.

- Laddered credits: finance confirmed they can implement the tiered credit math in the billing engine. Proposed credit schedule to match their ladder: 99.6 -> 5% credit, 99.2 -> 10% credit, <98.0 -> 25% credit (percent of monthly Redwood hosting/usage charges). I'll attach the proposed exception matrix wording in the next email.

Next steps: Laura / Legal to review the precise contract language below. If legal is OK, I recommend approving the redline and sending a prepared DocuSign envelope.

Marissa Cole

Subject: RE: Draft MSA + Order Form — uptime carveouts (proposed language + DocuSign plan)

Peter — thank you for the detail and the matrix. We've worked through this internally and propose the following contract edits (high-level):

1) Planned Maintenance Exclusion: add a defined section that permits up to one (1) scheduled maintenance window of up to six (6) consecutive hours per calendar quarter that will not trigger Service Credit calculations provided Redwood:
   a) provides written notice to the customer at least twenty-one (21) days in advance;
   b) publishes a rollback plan and post-maintenance validation playbook to the customer prior to the window; and
   c) limits scheduled blackouts to two (2) per 12-month period unless mutually agreed in writing.

2) Overage / Overrun Treatment: any scheduled window that exceeds the contracted blackout due to actions under Redwood's control will be treated as an outage for credit calculations. Events caused by third-party dependencies will be evaluated in good faith with shared incident evidence and may be excluded.

3) Laddered Service Credits: integrate the proposed ladder into the Order Form billing appendix. We will apply credits to monthly Redwood charges according to the following schedule: 99.6–100.0 = no credit; 99.2–99.59 = 5%; 98.0–99.19 = 10%; <98.0 = 25%. Credits are limited to fees directly attributable to the Service in the billing period and subject to the Order Form definitions.

4) DocuSign Routing: we can prepare a counter-signed MSA + Order Form if NebulaOps confirms acceptance of the above language. We'll route the DocuSign envelope to procurement@nebulaops.com and legal@nebulaops.com; the envelope will include a marked redline PDF and a clean counter-signed copy for signature.

Please confirm by end of day PT on 09/03 and we'll create the envelope. If you'd like, we can also do a brief legal ops sync to finalize formatting.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Lead Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
